body: For bug1807-ci-inventory-doer: root read the current full-workspace log. Several failures have concrete harness contamination signatures: BUG1682 helpers execute normal CLI and reject --exact; BUG1749 built_aida_binary explicitly requires runner under deps and rejects ambient AIDA_BIN. Source lib.rs::aida_exe_path first uses aida_bin::process and caches it. Root inherited AIDA_BIN=/home/joe/ai/aida/target/agent, and run.py copies os.environ unchanged. Native launch may carry that coordinator override. Inspect actual failure diagnostics when the run ends; keep full failed run honest. For test-only commands, remove ambient coordinating AIDA_BIN (and any equivalent resolver override if documented) so subprocess tests resolve their own test executable; maintain fake HOME/live-home fences and canonical absolute CLI for actual AIDA coordination. This is test isolation, not permission to change product resolver or bypass authority. Re-run affected suites and, if signatures confirm the environmental cause, the full workspace under a sanitized test environment. No new unrelated source fixes. Report evidence and all residual failures; do not mark the initial full run passing.
subject: Concrete test-runner contamination evidence: inherited AIDA_BIN
